Îți foarte mulțumesc.definition: A more [elevated] type of [thank you] that you use when you feel like a simple [thank you] isn't enough.
Îți foarte mulțumesc.example: Îți foarte mulțumesc pentru lipeala pe [care] mi-ai făcut-o cu [fata] [asta].

Îdinism.definition:
In the context of Romanian [orthography], the name of a movement to remove the letter ⟨â⟩ from Romanian orthography either:
1. Completely, without exception; or
2. Sparing the word 'român' and its [derivatives]; e.g. 'România', 'românesc', or 'românism'.

The word is derived from [the Romanian] name of the letter ⟨î⟩, 'î din i' ('î from i') combined with the suffix -ism.
Îdinism.example: Mihaela and Robert are [proponents] of Îdinism; they support the complete removal of the letter 'â' from [the Romanian] [alphabet] in favour of the letter 'î'.
